mission: Ben, Talon, and Sela observe the Foundation/Vigil field camp: legitimate-looking survey work with Greyline/Greyline security underneath.
why_now: The Foundation camp is active and close to the Glasswell — Ben needs to understand the operation's size, security posture, and timeline before any move can be planned, and the only way to do that is direct observation from the ridge.
conflict: The camp looks procedurally legitimate from the ridge — survey markers, Foundation-branded equipment sleds, professional uniformed personnel — and Ben cannot act on what he suspects without proof that the Greyline security underneath is there for something other than protecting survey workers.
setting: Iresh, observation ridge above the Foundation/Vigil field camp — pale cliffs, mineral dust on the wind, Greyline security in unmarked grays patrolling a survey-classified perimeter. Foundation-branded equipment sleds and a small landing pad. Ben senses Aevyn's Force presence from the ridge before he sees him.

stakes.personal: From the observation ridge Ben automatically reads the camp the way GAG training taught him to — patrol intervals, sight lines, over-watched approaches, which Foundation staffers look like they do not know what the security is actually for. He notices himself doing it and does not stop.
stakes.interpersonal: Talon is counting guards in his head — Ben can tell by the way his eyes track — and he has not made a joke in ten minutes. Sela is watching the section of camp nearest the path she warned them not to use, and her jaw is set.
stakes.external: If Ben cannot identify Aevyn’s location and the cache’s approximate position from this ridge, they will have to go inside the perimeter blind — with no local legal cover and Greyline security authorized to detain anyone who approaches without Foundation credentials.

sensory_details: Pale mineral dust on the wind from the cliff face below the ridge — it leaves a fine coating on everything exposed for more than a few minutes. The camp’s equipment hum carries upslope. Ben notices the Foundation-branded canopy is staked with military-grade anchor bolts, not the quick-release civilian type. Below them, the mirror-lake surface catches the overcast sky in flat gray.

turning_point_detail.trigger: Ben extends his Force awareness past the camp's perimeter — not scanning for threats, just listening — and finds something that is not Greyline security or Foundation staffers. A presence that is quiet, controlled, and oriented inward rather than outward. Someone who knows how to not be read.
turning_point_detail.shift: Ben knows what that kind of Force presence means: it is not a soldier's focused alertness or a civilian's absence of awareness. It is the deliberate stillness of someone with training. Aevyn is inside the camp, and he is already working.
turning_point_detail.cost: Ben cannot tell how close Aevyn is to the cache. Every hour of observation is an hour Aevyn has been at it.

emotional_arc.start: Ben is in GAG-trained observation mode — professional, objective, reading the camp like a logistics problem — and keeping the discomfort of how natural that feels at arm's length.
emotional_arc.shift: The moment his Force sense finds Aevyn's presence, professional observation becomes personal recognition. He knows that kind of stillness. Jacen taught him to practice it.
emotional_arc.end: Ben pulls back from the Force contact before Aevyn can sense the touch, but the confirmation lands like a weight: Aevyn is there, he is operational, and the time for reconnaissance is ending.

key_beats.beat_description: The three of them hold the observation ridge and read the camp: Talon counts Greyline personnel and patrol intervals, Sela marks blocked Foundation paths, Ben reads the legitimacy surface and the security mass underneath.
key_beats.state_change: They complete a shared reconnaissance assessment — the camp's cover is identified as functional but over-secured.
key_beats.pov_reaction: the automatic satisfaction of a pattern completing correctly; the discomfort of noticing how automatic it is

key_beats.beat_description: Ben identifies the security posture as over-weighted for a standard survey — too many Greyline personnel in unmarked grays, too many sight lines toward the Glasswell side.
key_beats.state_change: The camp's legitimate surface is stripped away in his assessment — what remains is a security operation with charitable cover.
key_beats.pov_reaction: GAG-trained read completing without effort; a familiar competence he has not decided whether to own

key_beats.beat_description: Ben extends Force awareness carefully into the camp and finds Aevyn's deliberately quiet presence near the Glasswell access.
key_beats.state_change: Aevyn's location inside the perimeter is confirmed — he is already operational, not staging.
key_beats.pov_reaction: recognition before identification; the specific texture of someone who was taught how to not be read

key_beats.beat_description: Ben pulls back before Aevyn can feel the probe, but the confirmation is complete.
key_beats.state_change: Ben now knows Aevyn's position without triggering a counter-awareness.
key_beats.pov_reaction: the breath held and released; the weight of confirmed intelligence settling

key_beats.beat_description: Ben tells Talon and Sela what he found; Talon counts what it means for their timeline and stops joking.
key_beats.state_change: The group's operational posture shifts — reconnaissance is over, and they are now planning against a known active threat.
key_beats.pov_reaction: the relief of having something concrete to report; the beginning of the next calculation
